text:
QUOTE: "Archive a channel | `app/actions/remote/channel.ts:1397-1401` | Sets `delete_at` locally and keeps the user as a member | Removes the current user from the channel locally" and "Archive event from websocket | ... | If the archived channel is current, emits `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED` and kicks the user out; then removes the user from the channel"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when archived channels aren't viewable, the user is removed from the channel and kicked out if it is current; when viewable, `delete_at` is set locally (channel marked deleted) and the user stays a member.
